name: fleeting_flight_prevents_combat_damage_to_it
notes: Printed: 'Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains flying until end of turn. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.' Seat 0's 2/2 attacks and seat 1's 4/4 blocks; after blocks seat 0 casts Fleeting Flight on its 2/2. It becomes a 3/3 with a +1/+1 counter and flying (the block stands, CR 509.1h), the 4/4's combat damage to it is prevented, and it deals 3 to the 4/4.
